svg.title: HyperWeave — The artifact layer for agent-human representations.
svg.desc: HyperWeave GitHub social card, noctilucent-indigo-ice colorway, horizontal lockup. Octahedral brand glyph, HYPERWEAVE in Orbitron SemiBold caps and the product tagline on a 1280x640 2:1 card. Field: opaque obsidian-indigo ground (#080C24).

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: GitHub repository social preview at the platform's 1280x640 spec — the card that renders in link unfurls on GitHub, Slack, X and LinkedIn, and the same artifact reused as a README hero.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Reformat, not rescale. The 1200x200 footer is a 6:1 strip whose composition is horizontal by necessity; a 2:1 card has vertical room, so the type scale is rebuilt for the new frame rather than the strip being stretched into it — cap height 36 -> 60, glyph scale 0.72 -> 1.3, and the tagline restored, since a preview card is read once by a stranger and must say what the thing is. Full-bleed hairlines at y=1.5 and y=638.5 bookend the field. Wordmark is Orbitron SemiBold outlined to a path atlas (8 glyphs, 10 placements); tagline is Heros outlined the same way.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Chose 1280x640 over the strip's aspect because GitHub crops social previews to 2:1 and a 6:1 banner arrives letterboxed with the lockup shrunk to illegibility. Note this file must be rasterised to PNG for Settings -> Social preview, which does not accept SVG; the SVG remains the source of truth and the README hero. Kept the singularity pulse even though the PNG export freezes it, because the SVG is also embedded live. Corrected two stops inherited from the noctilucent genome: the wordmark ramp terminal #233B99 measures 1.98:1 on #080C24 and the glyph ramp terminal #1B245A measures 1.33:1, against a declared floor of 5.12:1 — the last two letters and the bottom-right wire were effectively unlit. Raised to #5A82E8 (5.32:1) and #4E74D8 (4.41:1, above the 3:1 non-text threshold); hue, stop positions and the Bayer veil are untouched.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 1280x640 (2:1), bilateral about x=640. Horizontal two-cell lockup: glyph cell 208 centred (220.0,302), divider x=364.0 (96px), wordmark cap 60 on baseline 332.0 centred x=784.5, run 759.0. Lockup width 1048.0 (76% of canvas). Tagline baseline 418, run 630.3. Content block y 198-440, optical centre 319 against canvas centre 320.
